title: Create: Ectoplasm

body:
![Mod additions](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3dfecdf0c76ecfab0a2c71d1c1cd13305bcb1d1b_0.webp)
# Ectoplasm! 👻

This Create mod addon adds Ectoplasm as an efficient liquid fuel source. Process drops from ghostly mobs to refine it, then use it to power Furnaces, Blaze Burners, and more!

## Features

![Ecto Gland](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2f292f6fd6f3f9e51765b4707def10c279ff9e9f.png)

### Ecto Gland
Ghost-like mobs drop Ecto Glands. By default, the following mobs drop Ecto Glands:
* Allays
* Vexes
* Strays

In addition to mob sources, Ecto Glands can be crafted by breaking down Phantom Membranes (which drop as normal from Phantoms), yielding 4 Ecto Glands per Phantom Membrane. Rotten Flesh can be haunted for a small chance to receive an Ecto Gland.

The mod provides a Create cutting recipe to break down Phantom Membranes, as well as a compacting recipe for its inverse.

---

![Ectoplasm](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/dfeb5fa15b9f4bffbf467e53373153afc62109f8.gif)

### Ectoplasm
Ectoplasm is a liquid fuel source which burns for 24000 ticks per 1000mB by default (about 16% more efficient than lava).

It can be created by heating a mixture of 4 Ecto Glands and 1000mB of water, for a yield of 250mB of Ectoplasm.

Ectoplasm can also be compacted back into Ecto Glands.

---

![Ectoplasm Bucket](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3058cb5295febf52e562516fb191283087aba98e.png)

### Bucket of Ectoplasm
Ectoplasm can be bucketed and used as a fuel source by fuel-accepting blocks, such as Furnaces, Blaze Burners, and Portable Engines (if Create Aeronautics is also installed).

## Compatibility
Ectoplasm has inbuilt compatibility with [Create: Liquid Fuel](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-liquid-fuel) and [Create Aeronautics: Portable Engine Liquid Fuel](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-aeronautics-portable-engine-liquid-fuel).

With these mods installed, Ectoplasm in its liquid form can be piped directly into Blaze Burners and Portable Engines.
